new_scholarship.name: President's Welcome Award for International Students
new_scholarship.application_period: Considered automatically with the admission application for September 2027 entry. The award has no application and no separate deadline of its own.
new_scholarship.description: Carleton University's President's Welcome Award for International Students is a first-year entrance award of $2,000 to $5,000 CAD, awarded automatically on admission with an unlimited number of awards. It is paid in first year in addition to other Entrance Scholarships, and is restricted to international students entering directly from high school who pay international student fees.
new_scholarship.best_fit: International students applying directly out of high school to a Carleton bachelor's programme and paying international student fees.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: International undergraduate students entering directly from high school and paying international student fees. Consideration is automatic; final value depends on grades at the time of admission.
eligibility: Applying directly from high school - transfer students are not eligible for this award
Applying to a bachelor's degree programme with a September 2027 start date
coverage: First-year tuition, awarded in addition to other Entrance Scholarships
benefits: Value of $2,000 to $5,000 CAD depending on grades at the time of admission
Awarded in first year in addition to other Entrance Scholarships
requirements: Satisfy Carleton admission requirements and language requirements
Apply as an international student entering directly from high school
new_scholarship.selection_notes: Value is determined by grades at the time of admission. Entrance scholarship offers are not reassessed on final high school grades.
new_scholarship.notes: Carleton publishes this award as NEW on its entrance scholarships page for the 2027-2028 cycle. Separate official pages give a conflicting entry year and a conflicting total for the general entrance grid; see verification notes.

programme_detail_official.deadline_central_display: No application and no separate deadline - awarded automatically with the admission application
programme_detail_official.deadline_note: The award requires no application. Carleton states that for its renewable entrance scholarships a complete admission application and all required grades must be received by June 15; that June 15 date is published in the Canadian high school section, and the international high school section of the same page does not restate a deadline. No deadline is therefore asserted for the international route.
programme_detail_official.status_note: The 2027-2028 entrance cycle is published as current and applications for September 2027 entry are being accepted at the time of verification.
programme_detail_official.tuition_coverage_note: Awarded in first year in addition to other Entrance Scholarships. Carleton describes it as a first-year award; it does not state that it covers the full tuition fee.

programme_detail_official.description: Carleton University runs an automatic, merit-based entrance scholarship programme. International high school entrants with an 85%+ admission average are considered for a renewable entrance scholarship worth up to $12,000 over four years, and separately receive the President's Welcome Award for International Students, worth $2,000 to $5,000 in first year only. Neither requires an application.
programme_detail_official.coverage: Tuition assistance in first year; not living costs, not travel

application_readiness_checklist: Apply to a Carleton bachelor's programme as an international student with a September 2027 start
Be entering directly from high school - transfer students are excluded from the President's Welcome Award
Confirm you will be assessed at international student fees, not domestic fees
Submit the complete admission application with all required grades early, since the June 15 date published for entrance scholarships is the binding date for the renewable grid
Do not look for a scholarship application - there is none for this award
common_rejection_risks: Transferring from another institution rather than entering directly from high school
Being assessed at domestic fees, which routes you out of the international award
Admission average below 85 percent, which falls outside the renewable entrance grid
Missing the June 15 complete-application date for the renewable grid
Expecting renewal of the President's Welcome Award, which is first year only
Assuming the award is reassessed upward after final high school grades arrive - Carleton states it is not
estimated_uncovered_costs: Second-year and later tuition, since the President's Welcome Award is first year only
Travel, immigration and permanent residence costs
Any portion of tuition above the renewable grid maximum of $12,000 over four years
document_audit: No scholarship application documents - the award requires no application
Proof of international student fee assessment determines eligibility
English language requirement applies for the renewable grid but no score is published on the scholarship page
